name: @pipeworx/mcp-bigiron

tools.name: bigiron_search
tools.description: Search active US ag/construction/livestock/transportation equipment auctions on bigiron.com — a national online timed-auction platform. Returns live listings with current bid, Buy-It-Now asking price (if offered — NOT a sold price), make/model/year, seller, location and auction close time. Bids are served through a 5-minute result cache, so the current bid can be up to five minutes old: near the close of an auction treat it as a lower bound, never as the final price. Sourced from bigiron.com/Search.

query.description: Search keywords, e.g. "tractor", "skid steer", "Angus bred heifers"

page.description: Result page, starting at 1 (each page holds 20 lots)

tools.name: bigiron_sold_search
tools.description: Search CONFIRMED-SOLD equipment lots on bigiron.com for comps — title, make/model/year, quantity, seller, location and close date for lots that actually sold. IMPORTANT: bigiron.com does not expose the realized hammer price in this page shape (verified: 0/100 sampled sold lots carry a nonzero price field, even with 60+ bids) — final_price is always null with an explanatory note; num_bids is the closest available demand signal. Use bigiron_search for current asking prices instead. Sourced from bigiron.com/Search?filter=Sold.

page.description: Result page, starting at 1 (each page holds up to 20 lots)

tools.name: bigiron_lot_detail
tools.description: Full detail for one bigiron.com lot by its URL slug: description, sale status, bid count, make/model/year, seller, location, category and (for active lots) current bid / Buy-It-Now price. Slugs come from bigiron_search or bigiron_sold_search result urls (the part after /Lots/). Bids are served through a 5-minute result cache, so the current bid can be up to five minutes old: near the close of an auction treat it as a lower bound, never as the final price. Sourced from bigiron.com/Lots/{slug}.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-bigiron forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the bigiron pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
